rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_constrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.3, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, rationale=iter-3 EXPLORATORY, single knob fd_recon_dc_relax 0.5->1.0 from iter-2 base (init_t=0.3). SIX-BOX: (1)PRIOR: iter-2 (init_t0.3) hr=0.0: ssim jumped 0.775->0.908 but val_rmse only 0.01366->0.01307, still 2.5x the 128-view FBP baseline rmse 0.00521 (psnr 28.34 vs 36.32dB). Lowering init_t fixed structure (ssim) but barely moved the RMSE-driven headroom. (2)FAILURE MODE: recon not tightly anchored to the strong 128-view measured data - dc_relax=0.5 only HALF-applies the CG projection, letting the cross-dataset prior keep the RMSE high. (3)ONE KNOB: fd_recon_dc_relax 0.5->1.0 (full data-consistency; init_t=0.3 held). (4)HYPOTHESIS: full CG projection onto the measured 128-view sinogram each Euler step drags the recon RMSE down toward the FBP floor (0.00521) while keeping iter-2 structure, moving hr off 0. (5)BUDGET: iter-2 fast; same steps=8/n_cg=5, negligible cost change. (6)Loop continues; iter-4 self-dispatched on landing. Reserved: fd_recon_steps, fd_recon_dc_n_cg, fd_recon_eta.
